prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1133; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries that are still under medical evaluation, and we expect the full extent of those injuries and associated losses to be documented as treatment continues.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any adjuster or representative who needs information should reach out to us instead.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, along with a declaration of any excess or umbrella coverage.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
